_readme: S447 SkyBrittlebush, 2026-10-22. Mt. San Jacinto's capture finds 99 of 174 programs: 28 not found and 25 page-claimed, and S446's free capture under the per-heading rules moved neither (100 found, 24 page-claimed). The losers fall back to the general education and C-ID chart pages because their own page was never a candidate: Anthropology, History and Kinesiology AA-T, Administration of Justice A.S., A.S.-T and certificate, Chemistry and Public Health Science AS-T, Studio Arts AA-T, Alcohol & Drug Studies, Interpreter Preparation, Aviation Science, Horticulture. Found pages sit at /instructional-programs/<discipline>/<program>/. This read asks the sitemap whether it lists those programs' pages, and the program index which addresses it links. Two loads, no model call.

questions.sitemap_program_pages: Whether the sitemap lists the missing programs' pages, and at which addresses.
